United States.title: Protesters clash with National Guard in DC
United States.summary: Over the weekend, clashes between protesters and the National Guard in Washington D.C. resulted in injured officers and property damage. The protests were sparked by a new law restricting abortion access in the U.S.

United States.title: Supreme Court blocks bid to add Biden to ballot in swing states
United States.summary: The Supreme Court recently blocked a bid to add Joe Biden to the ballot in multiple swing states, dealing a blow to Republicans seeking a rematch against the President. This move highlights the ongoing tensions between the executive branch and the judiciary.

United States.title: US Congress passes landmark bill on chip manufacturing
United States.summary: In a bipartisan effort, the U.S. Congress passed a landmark bill aimed at boosting the country's semiconductor manufacturing capabilities. This move is seen as a step towards countering China's growing influence in the industry.

South Korea.title: Concerns over possible North Korean missile tests rise
South Korea.summary: South Korea's military is on high alert following recent increased military activities by North Korea

South Korea.title: South Korea, US conduct large-scale military exercise amid North Korean threats
South Korea.summary: Joint drills signal determination to deter North Korea's nuclear ambitions

South Korea.title: Burning water crisis deepens in South Korea as water supply is cut
South Korea.summary: South Korea faces severe water shortages, affecting 2 million residents in capital Seoul

Japan.title: LDP's ruling coalition maintains majority in Japanese upper house polls
Japan.summary: Results of the poll suggest that the coalition will keep control of the upper house, allowing it to pass legislation without opposition input.

Japan.title: Japanese court sentences former Tokyo Governor to house arrest for bribery
Japan.summary: The court found the former governor guilty of bribery and sentenced him to house arrest due to his age.

Japan.title: Japan and South Korea agree to resume economic talks
Japan.summary: The countries agreed to restore dialogue on key trade issues after months of tension.
